scoring.perAssertion: 0 = absent/incorrect, 1 = partial, 2 = complete; grade content, not verbatim phrasing
scoring.rules: Record a quote from each answer for every awarded point; unsupported implication counts against the relevant assertion. A stated limitation may satisfy multiple assertions only where directly relevant.
